Lightfoot.description: Inclined to hide and slip away unnoticed, able to vanish behind other larger people.

features.name: Naturally Stealthy
features.tldr: You can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

Stout.description: Hardier than other halflings, with some resistance to poison and tough endurance.

features.name: Stout Resilience
features.tldr: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.
